card.name: Black-Necked Stork
card.description: The only species of stork found in Australia, the Black-Necked Stork is a tall, long-necked wading bird with striking black and white plumage and a heavy bill. It inhabits wetlands and floodplains, feeding on fish, amphibians, and invertebrates.
card.photo_credit: From the Stingrays manual, source to confirm
